text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with T.M. 
Opera O—

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: O-Opera O...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: You're... the one from back then...!

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
...I apologize. She was just so insistent 
on speaking with you.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, not at all. An invitation from a 
princess is always more than welcome.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ha, was my gaze too intense for the 
princess?! Did the brilliance of my eyes 
make you nervous—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, whatever shall I do...! All because I 
was cursed with such captivating eyes...!"
choice_data_list: Mind if we talk while we walk a bit?

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, if it's just for a short while. 
Please, for her sake as well. ...I will be 
waiting right here.

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: ...Is this... Opera O's... school?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That's right. It's the place where I train 
daily and polish our beauty together with 
my friends.

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
Opera O... is trying... her best, isn't 
she?

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it, I'm just... ...*sniff*, 
*sob*...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: My princess?! What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
I knew it... I can't... become sparkly... 
like Opera O... *sob*... *sniff*, *hic*, 
*pant*...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No, leave that to me! You take care of the 
princess here!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to be... like Opera O. Get rid 
of the sickness... and sparkle."

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
And, but... surgery is still so scary. 
I... couldn't become... Opera O. I wanted 
to... see you...

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
...*sniffle*. Opera O... is there 
anything... you're afraid of?

What T.M. Opera O fears... That's a rather 
difficult question, but—
choice_data_list: I wonder if it's my own beauty...

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
“I see... Opera O is... pretty, after 
all...”

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Trainer-kun, you should say things 
like that boldly right to my face!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I felt summoned by the secret garden, you 
see. I called the nurse and immediately 
came fluttering back.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"—By the way, my princess. Do you know the 
secret to beauty?"

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: The secret...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The answer is to bathe in my radiance! In 
this light that brings hope to so many!

Saying so, T.M. Opera O pressed a hand 
mirror into the young girl's hand.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Here, I'll lend you my hand mirror. Take a 
good, long look at it.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The you reflected here is beautiful. In 
other words... you are shining!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: "...Me... too? Am I... sparkling...?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, precisely! Though it seems you haven't 
realized it just yet!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Until you are convinced of that 
brilliance, let me lend you a hand mirror. 
Gaze upon yourself until your heart is 
content!"

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
"...Sparkly, just like me... ...Ehehe. You 
really think so...?!"

And with the nurse who rushed over shortly 
after, the little girl headed off to the 
hospital. ...Together with the smile 
reflected in the hand mirror.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I heard from the nurse earlier. She's 
scheduled for surgery, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I hear it's not life-threatening, but that 
doesn't make it any less scary. ...Shall 
we go see her on that day?

"Together with T.M. Opera O, I watched her 
small back fade into the distance."

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
...Operao really is amazing, isn't she? 
While I'm just... such a scaredy-cat...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: What is there to be down about!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I touched down a few seconds ago. The 
nurse should be arriving shortly as well."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, my princess. Let me say it once more. 
There is no need to feel down.

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My princess. Who is it that's reflected in 
your eyes right now?

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text: ...Uh... Um, Opera O...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Your eyes reflect me, the most 
beautiful being in all the world!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case! There won't even be 
room for fear to creep into view!

It was completely absurd... but looking at 
the young girl gazing at T.M. Opera O, her 
eyes were filled with pure anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
I seeee... Then if I just think about 
Opera O, I'm sure I won't be scared 
anymore!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
Ah... but... when I'm scared, will I 
really be able to remember...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: In that case, how about this?

Saying so, T.M. Opera O pressed a hand 
mirror into the young girl's hand.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That's the hand mirror that reflects my 
beauty every day. I have two, so I'll lend 
you one.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That mirror, having captured my 
brilliance, shall surely remind you of me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And it shall make you, who gazes upon me, 
shine as well! Just as the moon shines in 
the light of the sun!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas
text_block_list.text:
Y... Yeah! Ehehe... Opera O's mirror... 
huh...!

And with the nurse who rushed over shortly 
after, the little girl headed off to the 
hospital.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I heard from the nurse earlier. She's 
scheduled for surgery, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I hear it's not life-threatening, but that 
doesn't make it any less scary. ...Shall 
we go see her on that day?

"Together with T.M. Opera O, I watched her 
small back fade into the distance."
